source:
@@U00993@@
All right, then, well, this once I’ll let you off. I admit, it’s been a while since last we met. Besides, civilization is on the warpath, tidying up here and there and everywhere. It’s even got as far as the Devil. And as for that Nordic phantom we're used to, he’s gone, vanished, a thing of the past. No more horns, no more claws, no tapering tail that ends in a dart. And the foot, my cloven foot, which I really can’t do without, how would I ever explain it in social circles? And so, you see, like many a young buck, I've indulged in false calves for quite a few years now.

@@U00995@@
(Dancing.)

@@U00996@@
Ah, I'm near to losing my mind to see Squire Satan back in town!

@@U00998@@
Woman, don’t use that name to me!

@@U01000@@
But why? Why not? What’s wrong with it?

@@U01002@@
It’s been demoted—to fairy tale status. A scary something to frighten the children with. But humans are no better off. They're rid of the Evil One, but evil ones are still among them. So call me Baron, that will do nicely. A cavalier like all the others. And if there’s any doubt about my noble birth, here’s my coat-of-arms.

@@U01003@@
(He flips a finger.)
translation:
@@U00993@@
好吧，那么，好吧，这一次我就放过你了。我承认，距离上次见面已经有一段时间了。此外，文明正走在战争道路上，到处都在清理。甚至已经到了魔鬼的地步。至于我们所习惯的那个北欧幽灵，他已经消失了，消失了，成为了过去。不再有角，不再有爪子，不再有尖尖的尾巴。还有脚，我的分叉脚，我真的离不开它，我该如何在社交圈子里解释呢？所以，你看，像许多年轻的雄鹿一样，我已经沉迷于假小牛好几年了。

@@U00995@@
（跳舞。）

@@U00996@@
啊，看到撒旦乡绅回到城里，我都快要疯了！

@@U00998@@
女人，别用这个名字来称呼我！

@@U01000@@
但为什么呢？为什么不呢？有什么问题吗？

@@U01002@@
它已经被降级到童话般的地位。用来吓唬孩子的可怕的东西。但人类的处境也好不到哪儿去。他们消灭了邪恶者，但邪恶者仍然在他们之中。所以叫我男爵吧，这样就很好了。像其他人一样的骑士。如果对我的高贵出身有任何疑问，这是我的徽章。

@@U01003@@
（他转动一根手指。）
